lines.text: Did you know? Mov is Latin for move.
Quick quiz! Which means out plus move?

words.ex: Please remove your shoes before entering.
The motion of the ship made me feel sick.
It's natural to show emotion at a wedding.

publish.title: Mov root: remove, motion and emotion
publish.value: Mov comes from Latin "movere" (to move). Words: remove, motion and emotion. remove = re + move; emotion = e + mot.
